sourceTitle: Hamburger Hot Dish With French Fries
sourceText:
Hamburger Hot Dish With French Fries
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 25, 2009 - 12:06am

Ingredients




1 pound hamburger
1 1/2 cups chopped celery
1 cup chopped onions

Preparation

1 Brown these and then add: 1 can tomato soup 1 tsp. salt Pepper to taste 2 Put into a 9"x9" small casserole and cover with 9 ounces frozen French fries. Bake at 425 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes.
